description: Derived from AGSC-08-01: `agent` and `model` MUST be present when `origin` is `ai-assisted` or `ai-generated`, and a missing `agent` or `model` under an `ai-*` origin is AGSC-E202, a lint check because the schema keyword subset cannot express the condition. Two concepts are added to the minimal fixture, each conforming in every other key and a member of the fixture's cluster: `assisted` (origin ai-assisted, an agent and no model) and `generated` (origin ai-generated, with both). The whole list `lint` reports is one AGSC-E202 error naming the first file and item, and lint exits 1.

add_files.content/concepts/assisted.md:
---
type: concept
title: Assisted
description: A concept written with an assistant whose provenance names the agent and leaves out the model.
tags:
  - agents
  - patterns
clusters:
  - agent-patterns
prov:
  origin: ai-assisted
  agent: claude-code
  operator: human:tester
kind: principle
---

A principle.
